subject: Renewal procurement: onboarding handoff and PO streamlining for Helix Health
messages:
From: Sara Khan <sara.khan@helixhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 7 Mar 2029 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Procurement: Redwood renewal onboarding and PO streamlining

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the renewal summary this week. Procurement at Helix is asking for a clean onboarding path for vendor recertification and a straightforward PO flow so our finance team can finalize the PO before the end of the quarter.

Attached is our current SOW (Helix_Renewal_SOW_v1.pdf) and a brief list of internal approvals required. Can you confirm the following items so we can move to PO:
- Who will be the Redwood onboarding owner for vendor re-certification?
- The exact procurement portal steps (we need the URL and a one-page instruction for our Sourcing team)
- Any required security evidence or attestations we should upload alongside the PO (SOC2, logging SLA, data-retention notes)
- Whether a one-time uplift / seat increase (approx +30% capacity) requires an amended SOW or a separate PO

We'd like to have an internal procurement meeting next Tuesday; ideally the Redwood onboarding steps are in hand beforehand.

Thanks,
Sara Khan
Senior Procurement Manager
Helix Health

Attachment: Helix_Renewal_SOW_v1.pdf (pdf, 420 KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Khan <sara.khan@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 7 Mar 2029 13:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Procurement: Redwood renewal onboarding and PO streamlining

Hi Sara —

Appreciate the SOW. Quick responses inline and next steps below.

- Onboarding owner: I will own the vendor recertification from Redwood; Aditya will be the technical contact for portal access and evidence ingestion.
- Procurement portal: use this onboarding link (redwood portal, public guide attached) — https://redwood.app/portal/helix/onboard. I attached a one-page instruction PDF (redwood_procure_portal_instructions_v2.pdf).
- Security evidence: SOC 2 report and our data-retention matrix are the usual items; I will add a short attestation page for the renewal.
- Capacity uplift: for a +30% seat/capacity uplift we can accept a single PO referencing an amendment (no separate long SOW required). We'll attach an amendment stub when we receive the PO number.

Next steps (proposed):
1) You share the PO placeholder or DocuSign link with the procurement team.
2) Aditya and I will schedule a 30-min onboarding walkthrough for your sourcing & finance on Mon/Tue.
3) We will prepare the amendment stub for signature once the PO number arrives.

I can be on the call Tuesday at 9:30 PT — does that work for your team?

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Head of Renewals, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

Attachment: redwood_procure_portal_instructions_v2.pdf (pdf, 120 KB)
